title: Chegada — progressão no traçado e qualidade de desenho
direction: Pedido do Vitor: v3 sutil demais, sobretudo Rara versus Holográfica. Simplificar mais a Comum retirando elementos e fazer a progressão também no próprio traço, volume, pelo e acabamento.

tiers.common: Cartoon simples, contorno marcado, poucas sombras e cenário mínimo.
tiers.shiny: Ilustração intermediária com volume e cenário enxuto.
tiers.rare: Ilustração detalhada com luz trabalhada e traçado fino.
tiers.holographic: Acabamento mais pintado, fios de pelo e materiais mais ricos; mesmos objetos da Rara.

variants.label: Comum
variants.detail: TIER 1 — COMMON, DELIBERATELY SIMPLE CARTOON. Redraw the entire photo, INCLUDING PUPPY, in an attractive clean simple 2D cartoon language: noticeably bold confident dark outer contours, just a few big graphic tufts to suggest fur (NO fine hair strands), simple solid black and tan color regions, only ONE clear shadow tone, simple flat brown eyes with small white catchlight, simple nose shape. Puppy still adorable, expressive and recognizable, same head tilt and paw pose. BOX is simple flat brown planes with a few fold lines, blanket broad cream/red shapes with virtually no fiber texture. Remove all secondary props: NO rug, NO rope ball, NO biscuit, NO plant, NO picture frame. Background is plain warm cream wall and a simple smooth wooden floor; a very simple left window silhouette suggests home. Large calm color areas, generous negative space. Professional polished MINIMAL cartoon, visibly much simpler in linework, shading and dog fur than original reference, not a detailed illustration merely blurred in background.

Same camera and dog size, same cream blanket with red stripe draped on LEFT flap. Preserve character identity and newborn age exactly. Warm welcoming home, daytime light from LEFT. variants.label: Brilhante
variants.detail: TIER 2 — SHINY, POLISHED STANDARD STORYBOOK CARTOON. The same puppy/box/blanket composition but now clearly a step richer than flat cartoon: medium thin varied ink contour, distinct layered fur LOCKS (still not individual hairs), 2-3 clean cel-shaded tones that give roundness to cheeks and paws, glossy expressive eyes, softly shaped nose. Warm friendly soft windowlight. Box gets natural folds and blanket a little woven texture. Simple sparse room: left window, a plain red/cream rug under box and ONE softly drawn right plant. NO rope ball, biscuit or framed picture yet. Keep environment clean and low contrast. This is the middle-quality sweet illustrated version, visibly rounder and more detailed than common, but not the rich fine fur/rendering of rare or top tier.

variants.label: Rara
variants.detail: TIER 3 — RARE, HIGH-QUALITY DETAILED ANIMATION ILLUSTRATION. Same baby pose and size, in same box. Richly drawn layered silky fur tufts, finer expressive variable linework, nuanced amber eye color and glossy highlights, richer but still clearly CEL-SHADED 2D volumes on face and paws. Beautiful coherent directional warm windowlight and soft natural shadows give much better depth than standard cartoon. Blanket has visible soft knitted texture; cardboard has fine fold edges and subtle grain. Sparse background: soft left window, red/cream round rug, single right plant, small simple picture frame behind, and one small red/cream rope ball at lower right. No other props. Keep visible ink contours, grouped fur tufts and some fairly clean cel-shaded planes: this should be a beautiful refined illustration but MUST leave room for the final tier's far more intricate painterly craftsmanship. Dog remains highest contrast focal point.

variants.label: Holográfica
variants.detail: TIER 4 — TOP RARITY, SUBSTANTIALLY MORE SOPHISTICATED PREMIUM PAINTED 2D KEY ART. Same tiny black-and-tan FLOPPY-EARED baby, same head tilt/box/paws/blanket and EXACT same sparse objects as RARE (window, rug, ONE plant, small frame, ONE rope ball); add NO objects. Visibly upgrade the ACTUAL DRAWING AND RENDERING far beyond ordinary cel shading: exceptionally fine tapered selective linework instead of heavy continuous contours, beautifully hand-painted fur with many delicate individual strand clusters over soft underfur, nuanced multi-layer warm/cool transitions and natural reflected light, soft translucent ear-edge fuzz, tiny whiskers, richly painted deep amber eyes with subtle realistic window reflections, detailed velvety nose and expressive soft muzzle. Still unmistakably a charming DRAWN 2D storybook puppy, NOT a photograph, 3D render or older dog. Cardboard has believable subtle fibers and corrugation with soft painted edge light; blanket has lovingly rendered individual wool fibers, rope toy has fine braided threads. Use premium cinematic painted light, restrained natural contrast, rich color depth and atmosphere. Background has soft painterly lost edges and gentle depth-of-field so all fidelity draws attention to the puppy. Top tier should look like the highly finished cover illustration or animation key visual compared with RARE's cel-shaded storybook still. No foil/rainbow/glitter/gold halo. The jump from third to fourth should be obvious in line delicacy, fur microstructure, painted shading and material realism, not brightness or busyness.
